mid.name: Stamina Mastery
mid.annotation: You can't not have Stamina Mastery in any build ever. If you feel you don't need it, swap it out Ultra Late for a t4 green of your choice.

mid.name: Hollow Point

late.name: Mystic Reverb

late.name: Spirit Burn

late.name: Glass Cannon

1998374645.annotation: Early game with these 3 items 3 starts dealing like 200 damage every 15s.

690458959.annotation: Testing has shown that this item outperforms Hollow Point for sniping, because of the large added damage to your shots, but unfortunately Carbine only gets the smaller secondary fire damage buff.

2121044373.annotation: Massive 3 damage, try to play around the cooldown, 3's cooldown starts ticking as soon as you start charging it, so you can wait for the very last second with no downtime.

3261353684.annotation: Very low priority, your 3 is the only thing we care about.

3577481646.annotation: This is literally just 50% more damage, and the aoe will easily deal thousands of damage in teamfights.

343572757.annotation: Always useful, the antiheal aspect makes you contribute a lot more in teamfights, and it's super easy to prock, aswell as having high damage.

2678489038.annotation: Good damage and the effect procks with carbine, so your target will lose resists and be easier to kill for you or your team, but it depends on your health and has ever so slightly worse snipes.

915014646.annotation: This finishes our spirit investment after buying Mercurial Magnum, buying it before then isn't usually optimal.// With the increased movespeed spirit scaling change this is now viable earlier.

395867183.annotation: Don't sell until giga late game, it's essentially the perfect item for sniping.

3074274290.annotation: Just walk up to people for assists as they die. Sell lategame first once your slot locked and only have t4's left.

3585132399.annotation: Very fast, very 4.8k, very heal. In actuality, this is mostly a roaming and sustain item, you should sell it second after trophy collector for other damage items. //4.8k spike.

393974127.annotation: The slow is good early, and it's consistent, cheap gun damage. | If you chose Hollow Point, sell this third to buy a t4 gun item.

3791587546.annotation: The unconditional weapon damage slightly outperforms Hollow Point, the added slow is useful, and it's easier to build then the alternative, but your overall DPS and team damage fall considerably.

334300056.annotation: You can't not have Stamina Mastery in any build ever. If you feel you don't need it, swap it out Ultra Late for a t4 green of your choice.

365620721.annotation: Highest gun damage item in the game, and since our playstyle is so safe its incredibly easy to stack.

3884003354.annotation: It's mostly useful in longer fights, not as good for pure sniping, still, has massive value in teamfights, try to go for headshots if your too far away to target one person.

1396247347.annotation: Finish our gun investments, and good for normal gun damage. | You can replace it with a green that gives ~15% gun damage (since thats how much you get from final investment) if you wont m1.

3919289022.annotation: Last item, we swap Mystic Shot for this, and altough our 3 damage does go down a bit, we finish our spirit investments and get a significant boost to our base gun damage after using 3.

4139877411.annotation: We take Stamina over other greens because it helps us stay out of other champion's effective range, we dont need to mitigate damage that we dont take.

1770441818.annotation: Low prio, it's decent if your entire team is gun carries tho.

1644605047.annotation: If they have 4+ stuns on the enemy team, will probably sell, or build into indomitable for long range displacements like Bepop hook.

3270001687.annotation: This build affords one green item, it's usually this or Stamina Mastery, I prefer warp stone for jukes, but I know most like the other.

2163598980.annotation: You shouldn't ever be close enough to get hit by anyone, but still spirit resilience is just mandatory in this meta.

3731635960.annotation: For the long range roots like Vindicta 1, you can't let them get close.

1414025773.annotation: It's counterspell. What else do you want me to say?

1378931225.annotation: Haze or other few on-hit damage carries.
